description: This file is a test script for benchmarking and comparing CLI startup times and memory usage against a baseline fixture. It processes command-line arguments, runs a benchmarking subprocess, loads baseline and current report data, and checks for regressions in duration and RSS metrics, reporting any violations.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a string with one decimal place followed by 'ms'.

methods.name: formatMb
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a string with one decimal place followed by 'MB'.

methods.name: resolveCurrentReportPath
methods.description: Determines the path of the current benchmark report, either from a specified argument or by executing a report generation process.

methods.name: indexCases
methods.description: Creates a map from case IDs to case objects from the report data for easy lookup.
